s31_simboost.py.note: The simulation at the size the review requires: 1,000 replicates in each of six worlds at 100 nested refits each, a ten-cell (n,K) plane to K=3,019, three block lengths around n^(1/3), and seven interval constructions including m-out-of-n at m=n^(2/3). The core and block experiments ran 24 August 2026 as --only core,block; the grid ran as --resume, which also re-summarised all three with the experiment-aware key. Imports the world generator and the enumerated truth from s10 rather than copying them.

s49_dcaband.py.note: Round twenty-seven: the decision-curve band's measured shortfall, applied rather than reported. Section 10.4 measured a widening of 1.90-2.05 for these families and Section 8.3 printed counts from a band that never received it. The factor is s41's heavy-regime shortfall_factor at its conservative end, chosen because this family is measured into that regime (2 of 248 cells degenerate against a corpus maximum of 17.2 per cent, kurtosis matching heavy) rather than assigned to it; the degenerate-regime factor is reported beside every count. Pure arithmetic on existing draws, no refits.
